sections.title: 1. Change Summary
sections.prompt: In 2–5 sentences: what fulfilling the task introduces, modifies, or removes in the system (behaviors, contracts, data, responsibilities, etc.).

sections.title: 2. Impact Map
sections.item_schema: `<path, module, service, endpoint, screen, or data>` — Relationship: <origin | upstream | downstream> — <one-line effect description> — Impacts: <impact ids, e.g. I1, I2>

fields.name: Evidence
fields.prompt: File paths, references, docs, or history

fields.name: Consequence
fields.prompt: What goes wrong, and for whom, if unaddressed

fields.name: Disposition
schema: Mitigate via: <obligation ids, e.g. O1, O2> (Settled in: Q<n>)

fields.name: Requirements
fields.prompt: What must hold, verifiable from outside the component
